Goodhart decay: metrics selected for local correctness optimize away the unmeasured affordances future changes depend on
Self-organized criticality: verified incremental edits accumulate structural correlations that push the system toward a percolation threshold of cascading faults
Entropy of the implicit contract space: each verified change adds hidden invariants, shrinking the lattice of future viable edits faster than code grows
Epistemic opacity: the system's behavior becomes computationally irreducible from its source text, making local proof of correctness irrelevant to global changeability
Ecosystem lock-in: co-evolution with external dependencies creates an entangled network whose joint state space eventually permits no independent local moves
Affordance network collapse: repeated optimization of existing interfaces eliminates nearby alternatives, stranding the system in a deep basin of the design landscape
